comparison.comparisonMethod: Keys use logical image, ecosystem/type, package name and advisory ID. Installed version and file path are evidence fields, not identity keys, so version or JAR filename changes do not inflate new/fixed vulnerabilities. Raw target occurrences and multiplicity changes remain separately counted. Newly reported scanner flags are not proof of newly introduced exploitable vulnerabilities.
comparison.scopeOfZeroApplicationFindingsClaim: Trivy full OS/library analysis of the24 exact final app image config IDs, under the recorded snapshot; not a claim that all possible vulnerabilities or JavaScript bundle dependencies are identifiable.

kafkaStorageTrial.guardChangeSinceExistingCycle: Only the fresh formatter argument changed to --cluster-id=<id>, preserving valid leading-hyphen UUIDs. Reconstructing the previous bytes matches the prior report guard hash. Existing-volume branch unchanged.

freshGuardFailureAndFix.cause: A valid cluster UUID starting with a hyphen was interpreted as an option when passed as a separate CLI argument.
freshGuardFailureAndFix.fix: --cluster-id=<id>, matching the upstream Docker wrapper;13focused shell tests and26cloud suite tests pass, including failing-then-passing leading-hyphen regression.

priorIndependentHarnessFailures.causeAndCorrection: Kafka4.3 consumer deprecation notice polluted stdout; use its supported --command-property option.
Console producer overrides compression.type with its codec option default none; use explicit --compression-codec lz4 and verify every stored batch.
One cold/emulated readiness CLI exceeded35s just before the broker logged started; retry command timeouts inside the overall bounded readiness budget.
